description: This file declares functions related to reftable writing, including setting hash values, creating a writer with a string buffer, and writing reftable data structures to a buffer. It includes multiple internal and external headers essential for reftable manipulation.

methods.name: cl_reftable_set_hash
methods.description: Sets a hash value at a specific index in a reftable hash array.

methods.name: cl_reftable_strbuf_writer
methods.description: Creates a reftable writer that writes into a string buffer with specified options.

methods.name: cl_reftable_write_to_buf
methods.description: Writes reftable reference and log records to a buffer using provided options.
